theory_html:
A. not as … as

A. not as … as (không … bằng)

  • ‘I’m 93.’ ‘I’m 96.’ She’s old, but she’s not as old as he is.

    ‘Tôi 93 tuổi.’ ‘Tôi 96 tuổi.’ Bà ấy già, nhưng không già bằng ông ấy.

  • Box A isn’t as big as Box B.

    Hộp A không lớn bằng hộp B.

  • Rome is not as old as Athens. (= Athens is older)

    Rome không cổ bằng Athens. (= Athens cổ hơn)

  • The Grand Hotel isn’t as expensive as the Europa. (= the Europa is more expensive)

    Khách sạn Grand không đắt bằng khách sạn Europa.

  • I don’t play tennis as often as you. (= you play more often)

    Tôi không chơi quần vợt thường xuyên bằng bạn.

  • The weather is better than it was yesterday. It isn’t as cold. (= as cold as it was yesterday)

    Thời tiết đẹp hơn hôm qua. Không lạnh bằng hôm qua.

B. not as much as … / not as many as …

  • I don’t have as much money as you. (= you’ve got more money)

    Tôi không có nhiều tiền bằng bạn.

  • I don’t know as many people as you. (= you know more people)

    Tôi không quen nhiều người bằng bạn.

  • I don’t go out as much as you. (= you go out more)

    Tôi không ra ngoài nhiều bằng bạn.

C. not as … as and than

C. not as … as và than

not as … asthan
Rome is not as old as Athens.Athens is older than Rome. (not older as Rome)
Tennis isn’t as popular as football.Football is more popular than tennis.
I don’t go out as much as you.You go out more than me.

We usually say: as me / as him / as her etc. You can say:

Ta thường nói: as me / as him / as her v.v. Có thể nói:

  • She’s not as old as him. or She’s not as old as he is.

    Bà ấy không già bằng ông ấy.

  • You don’t work as hard as me. or You don’t work as hard as I do.

    Bạn không làm việc chăm bằng tôi.

D. the same as …

D. the same as … (giống như)

  • The weather today is the same as yesterday.

    Thời tiết hôm nay giống như hôm qua.

  • My hair is the same colour as yours.

    Tóc tôi cùng màu với tóc bạn.

  • I arrived at the same time as Tom.

    Tôi đến cùng lúc với Tom.

mcq.question: She’s old, but she’s not ___ old as he is.
mcq.full: She’s old, but she’s not as old as he is.
mcq.vi: Bà ấy già, nhưng không già bằng ông ấy.
mcq.expl:
not as + adjective/adverb + as = less than (Rome is not as old as Athens).
not as + tính từ/trạng từ + as = không … bằng (Rome is not as old as Athens).
Điểm ngữ pháp: not as … as.
mcq.key: She’s old, but she’s not ___ old as he is.|as
